evidence.summary: Each component killed once and returned healthy via a new launch: web 55s, api 53s, worker wrapper 46s, redis (service stop) 51s, cloudflared 56s (new link, public /login 200, /auth/me 401). Second supervisor copy exits in 1.8s (mutex). Clean stop+restart 67s to all healthy; healthy processes adopted. Orphaned 8001 listener (dead owner pid) resolved to its live child. Self-verification by the implementation run.

rationale: Measured recovery under 60s for every component with a 30s cycle; single instance proven; supervisor left running.
